title: Unbound Combat Compat
description:
(THIS ONLY WORKS FOR VERSION 1.0)

adds a recipe for the Ancient Dagger from Unbound Combat because it doesnt work with some select mods
body: Using Datapacks, this adds a simple recipe for the Ancient Dagger from Unbound Combat, there's not a ton of other stuff, so im putting filler because its dead simple. i guess i can yap about how it's using an iron ingot, a netherite ingot, and a stick, but thats not that important.
